outcomes.DID_NOT_FIT: did not fit in the model's input
outcomes.PARSE_FAILURE: the model's reply could not be read
outcomes.PROVIDER_ERROR: the model provider returned an error
outcomes.TIMED_OUT: not finished within the time limit

stop_reasons.runaway: the model kept thinking and gave no answer

topics.neighbours: Before and after: neighbours, sources, isolation

store_states.holds_other: The graph database currently holds plant {held}; it can hold only one plant at a time. So on this plant only the graph agent answers - this is not exactly the evaluated cascade.
store_states.empty: The graph database is empty, so on this plant only the graph agent answers - this is not exactly the evaluated cascade.
store_states.wrong_profile: The configured ingest file was not built with the database step's profile, so on this plant only the graph agent answers.
store_states.mismatch: The plant in the graph database does not match the configured one (different counts), so on this plant only the graph agent answers.
store_states.unreachable: The graph database is not reachable, so on this plant only the graph agent answers - this is not exactly the evaluated cascade.

job_states.refused: You have reached the session cost limit.

error_codes.unknown_job: Unknown job; the server may have restarted in the meantime.
error_codes.unknown_question: Unknown example question for this plant.
error_codes.corpus_not_ready: The plant is still loading, or loading it failed.
error_codes.busy: A question is already running; wait for it to finish.
error_codes.missing_file: A file is missing on the server.
error_codes.no_api_key: The demo has no model API key, so it cannot answer.
